MIND. [1] [Arum. t.]
Unconscious of what he is doing or what is said to him.
Great delirium. θ Scarlatina. θ Typhus.
During delirium, boring in nose ; picking at one spot, or at dry lips. θ Typhoid.
Mania.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Arum. t.]
Complains of dizziness on being raised. θ Scarlatina.
Giddiness.
Dull, heavy head, morning.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Arum. t.]
Violent headache.
Dull headache, upper part feels cold as if open and without covering.
Headache, pressing on right or both sides ; < from hot coffee ; > after dinner and after breakfast.
Tearing in right forehead, temple and ear, down to maxillary bone.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Arum. t.]
Head burning hot. θ Scarlatina.
Tinea capitis.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Arum. t.]
Aversion to light.
Eyes heavy ; sleepy.
Smarting of eyes.
Quivering of left upper lid.
Catarrh of lachrymal sac, with desire to bore into side of nose.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Arum. t.]
Left parotid gland sore to touch. θ Scarlatina.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Arum. t.]
Nose stopped up, < left side, must breathe through mouth, < mornings.
Sneezing ; < at night.
Fluent coryza, acrid.
Corrosive yellow nasal discharge, nostrils raw. θ Diphtheria.
Acrid ichorous discharge, excoriating inside of nose, the alæ and upper lips. θ Scarlatina.
Drink passes up through nose.
Nose feels stopped up in spite of watery discharge. θ Scarlatina.
He can only breathe with mouth open. θ Scarlatina.
Nose stopped, with or without profuse yellow discharge.
Sneezing as from taking cold, with repeated chills over whole body, beginning in vertex ; afternoon.
Nostrils sore, < left ; nose, lips and face chapped, as from a cold wind.
Constant picking at nose until it bleeds.
Desire to bore into side of nose. θ Catarrh of lachrymal sac.
Could hardly talk on account to phlegm in back part of nose ; hawking difficult.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Arum. t.]
Heat in face, afternoons ; with coryza.
Swollen, bloated face. θ Scarlatina.
Left face feels chapped, as if he had walked in cold wind.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Arum. t.]
Pain in joint of left inferior maxilla, as if sprained, when swallowing.
Lips as if scalded, mornings.
Lips chapped, as after exposure to cold wind.
Lips burning, swollen, cracked and bleeding.
Picks lips until they bleed, corners of mouth sore, cracked and bleeding. θ Scarlatina.
Children will often pick and bore into raw surfaces, though doing so gives great pain, and they scream with it, but keep up boring. θ Scarlatina.
Lips very sore and swollen, skin peeling off. θ Diphtheria.
Appearance of raw, bloody surfaces, on lips, buccal cavity, nose, etc., with great itching. θ Scarlatina.
Swelling of submaxillary and parotid glands, left < θ Scarlatina.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Arum. t.]
Tongue sore, red, papillæ swollen and elevated. θ Scarlatina.
Tongue cracked, burning, painful.
Root of tongue and palate feel raw.
Tongue cracked and bleeding.
Strawberry tongue.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Arum. t.]
Putrid odor from mouth. θ Diphtheritis.
Mouth felt so sore inside that he was unwilling to drink. θ Scarlatina.
Excessive salivation ; saliva acrid. θ Scarlatina.
The mouth burns and is sore that they refuse to drink, and cry when anything is offered. θ Scarlatina. θ Diphtheria.
Buccal cavity raw and bleeding.
Scanty but constant discharge of tough mucus from mouth with burning in throat.
Mouth dry, feels as if it would crack, has to get up at night to drink.
Mouth, lips and soft palate sore and burning, in morning.
Great sore feeling in mouth. θ Scarlatina.
Cavity of mouth covered with diphtheritic deposit and ulcers. θ Diphtheritis.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Arum. t.]
Sensation of swelling on soft palate, when swallowing ; with discharge of nasal mucus, in morning.
Soreness, burning, and pains in palate ; < when eating or drinking.
Fauces and nares ulcerated with a corroding acrid secretion.
As if tied together in throat, as if too narrow.
Constriction in throat (with sneezing).
Refuses food and drink on account of soreness of throat. θ Scarlatina.
Constant scratching and burning in throat, with desire to swallow.
Desire to swallow with stitching in throat, which is painful to pressure.
Difficult deglutition.
Stinging burning sensation in throat.
Burning pain in throat and in root of tongue, with dryness.
Burning in throat, in morning while in bed, > after rising.
Burning and dryness in throat, before midnight ; after midnight and towards morning, much mucus in throat, which goes deeper and deeper down by swallowing, and is perceived no more in morning after rising.
Tenacious mucus, with tickling cough.
Putrid sore throat.
Throat and tongue very sore, burning pains, putrid ulcers in throat. θ Scarlatina.
Throat livid, studded with deep angry looking ulcers having a fetid discharge. θ Scarlatina.
Swelling of glands on throat and neck.
Considerable swelling of submaxillary glands left side.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Arum. t.]
Children lose their appetite, don't want to play, lose flesh, have headache and scanty urine.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Arum. t.]
Between abdomen and legs sore moist places ; same on os coccygis. θ Scarlatina.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Arum. t.]
Stool : watery, dark brown, with eructation of food ; soft and painless, thin, yellow, in morning ; soft, with tenesmus ; at night, during sleep ; each succeeding discharge more watery.
Diarrhœa till noon, like mustard.
Diarrhœa dark yellow fluid. θ Typhoid fever.
Burning in anus.
Great soreness between abdomen, genitals and thighs, on and below os coccygis.
Between abdomen and legs sore moist places.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Arum. t.]
Frequent discharge of pale urine.
Urine very abundant and pale. θ Scarlatina.
Urine scanty or suppressed.
Very scanty secretion of urine, sometimes passing none for a whole day. (As soon as urine increases after it is given in scarlatina, the patient gets better. --Dr. L.) θ Scarlatina.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Arum. t.]
Cutting pain in either ovary.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Arum. t.]
Voice hoarse. θ Scarlatina.
Great hoarseness. θ Scarlatina.
Voice hoarse ; also from overexertion of voice in speaking or singing.
Voice uncertain, uncontrollable, changing continually ; now deep, hollow, then scarcely audible, and again high, shrieking.
Clergyman's sore throat ; hoarseness, < from talking.
Loss of voice after exposure to N. W. wind.
Burning of glottis, or pharynx.
Constant pain in larynx. θ Scarlatina.
In region of larynx considerable internal swelling of throat.
Accumulation of mucus in trachea.
   

COUGH. [27] [Arum. t.]
Distressing, hacking cough, after getting awake.
Expectoration of much mucus.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Arum. t.]
Burning in lungs when coughing, extending to pit of stomach.
Lungs feel sore.
Pain through left lung, about base of heart.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Arum. t.]
Pulse 140, hard and full. θ Scarlatina.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Arum. t.]
Stiff neck ; with intolerable pressing headache.
Sore, moist places on os coccygis.
Glands of neck and throat swollen. θ Scarlatina.
   

NERVES. [36] [Arum. t.]
Very great restlessness, child crying and throwing itself into all sorts of positions. θ Diphtheritis.
Greatest weakness or exhaustion. θ Typhus.
Spasms of arms and hands ; thumbs drawn in.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Arum. t.]
Child drowsy and stupid ; dark, livid eruption. θ Scarlatina.
Yawning in afternoon, with stretching and sleepiness.
Sleeplessness from soreness of mouth and throat, or from itching of skin.
On falling asleep feels as if she would smother. starts as if frightened.
Bad night ; very delirious 5th day of scarlet fever.
Restless tossing about in bed, desire to escape.
   

FEVER. [40] [Arum. t.]
Fever heat very intense. θ Scarlatina.
Typhoid forms of fever ; picking ends of fingers and dry lips till they bleed ; boring nose ; restless tossing about bed, wants to escape ; unconscious of what he is doing or of what is said to him ; urine suppressed ; great weakness (last stages probably with uræmia).
Child falls into a typhoid condition, with apathy. θ Scarlatina.
   

SKIN. [46] [Arum. t.]
Itching with desquamation, following a scarlet rash.
Eruption all over body, with much itching and restlessness. θ Scarlatina.
Exanthema like scarlet rash ; skin peels off afterwards.
Desquamation a second or third time, in large flakes, in scarlatina.
Little round, red, hard pimples all over body, legs, arms and face.
Eruption more in patches than uniform. θ Scarlatina.
Scarlatina, when characteristic symptoms of nose, mouth and throat (See 7, 12, 13) are present ; fever very intense ; in one case rawness down inner side of thighs.
Appearance of petechiæ. θ Scarlatina.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Arum. t.]
Clergymen, orators', singers', actors', auctioneers' sore throat ; even the highest potencies, one drop, have restored the voice in a few hours.
